artboards.title: The research, and what came of it

annotations.text:
Top row is the deliverable: Overview reworked, then Insights in both its states — what it shows before you ask, and what it shows after.

Bottom row is the argument: the road not taken, and where the principles came from.

The analysis is not a tab. It is what fills Insights before a conversation exists — correlations, day-of-week patterns and anomalies, all from endpoints the server already computes. "Ask about this" lands in the same column.
